rules._note: Betting rules backed by backtests against closing lines. Edit these when weekly grading says so.

tz_spot.hit: 55% overall (129), 59% since 2021; 62% if kickoff 10pm ET or later (69)

nfl.side_note: no proven edge vs closing line; small-stake leans only, key numbers 3/7

betting._note: Which picks become bets and how $ are split. p = backtest hit rate vs closing line, n = games behind it.
betting._stake_method: fractional Kelly on a shrunk hit rate (p*n + 0.5*k)/(n + k), scaled so each day's stakes add to the budget

cfb_wind_under.src: published CFB wind studies (n discounted - not our data)

nfl_side_gap4.src: our 2025 NFL test (below threshold - lean only)

betting.excluded: time-zone spots where the model disagrees; any game passed with --skip

cfb.model: Season-to-date opponent-adjusted team stats + home field + pregame Elo gap, ridge regression trained 2023-25
cfb.test: Trained 2023-24, scored 2025 (567 games with closing lines)
rows: spreads do not beat the market
spots: East team flying 2+ zones west: bet home

nfl.model: Ridge opponent-adjusted ratings (4-week half-life, 20% prior season), garbage time removed, play-by-play QB values, home/wind/division/travel; trained 2014-25
nfl.test: Walk-forward: each season 2023-25 predicted by a model trained only on earlier seasons (816 games)
rows: no stats-based edge vs NFL closing lines
